name: Library check-up
about: Looks over every Object in the Library: the Library check (2D and 3D agree, limits, every parameter does something) and the checks for sense (finishes that suit their parts, a description that says what it is). Plain code, no tokens; nothing is changed. The report says what to look at.

input.about: Nothing: it looks over the whole Library. Run it after Objects are merged, or now and then.

rules.text: Nothing changes: the Library changes only by pull request. The report is the output; fixes are new versions, proposed as usual.

steps.name: Look over the Library
steps.outcome: Every Library Object checked for form and sense, with what to look at for each.

output.name: Library check-up
output.about: Every Object, sound or with what to look at.

useWhen: The owner wants to know which Library Objects need fixing (after merges, or now and then).
